name: 8130-3 and EASA Form 1 extractor
summary: UpBrains is a general-purpose document platform used by distributors, not an aviation-only product. Aviation teams can use its extractor to read FAA 8130-3 and EASA Form 1 release certificates and check each block.
paragraphs: UpBrains is a general-purpose document platform used by distributors, not an aviation-only product. Aviation teams can use its extractor to read FAA 8130-3 and EASA Form 1 release certificates and check each block.
whyItMatters: Release certificates are hand-keyed at receiving in many stores; extraction cuts typing and catches mismatches.
